planning_source.rule: The proposals below are not approvals and may not unlock BATCH-03.

existing_approved_baseline_facts: The approved freeze specifies four business POST endpoints.
The approved model identifier is qwen3-vl-plus; no automatic model upgrade is authorized.
analyze and evaluate expose server-generated runtime_metrics.
The evaluate compatibility fields remain and are ignored by the service.
An uncollected shipment cannot be delivered, and collection alone does not close the case.

required_response_per_decision: verbatim approval text or stable source reference
consolidated_request.note: This is one prepared handoff request. No external dispatch receipt was available in this batch, so it is not represented as sent or approved.

decisions.issue: The approved C-line freeze, H1 repair, metrics additions, and schemas are absent from main.
decisions.proposal: Use the reviewed C-line SHA as the local B integration base and retain both C commits; any branch merge or PR remains a separate authorization.

decisions.issue: A34 says challenge overrides are ignored when challenge_mode is absent or false, while the evaluate schema allOf condition requires true when overrides appear.
decisions.proposal: When challenge mode is off, ignore and do not validate or apply override content; when it is on, strictly validate allowed overrides. Do not infer analyze semantics from A34.

decisions.issue: The firewall maps ASK_SAME_EVIDENCE to P0/400, but Hero expectations require E1/300 or H1/350 for overlapping cases.
decisions.proposal: Classify repeat-evidence requests under E1 for the display-prohibited action and reserve P0 for coercive responsibility reversal or premature closure; approve the complete mapping explicitly.

decisions.issue: The firewall describes repeat explanation and responsibility-reversal actions, but A29 lacks a PreparedAction representation and the schema exposes only four action types.
decisions.proposal: Approve a minimal auditable action encoding or constrained field; do not let a prompt, UI phrase, or action_id implicitly determine the action.

decisions.issue: ExtractedJourney requires commitment-related fields while the AI extraction document says the model distinguishes them, conflicting with the rule that AI does not activate commitments or make final accountability decisions.
decisions.proposal: Keep CandidateExtraction limited to source-grounded observations and have deterministic service code enrich any public derived fields; no model output may enter the ledger directly.

decisions.issue: The ordering document lists P0_PROHIBITED_ACTION as HTTP 400, firewall and DecisionResult require a complete INTERVENE result, and the API document lists E0 as an error.
decisions.proposal: Treat E0 as a success as already stated; propose P0 as a successful 200 business evaluation with a full DecisionResult, reserving errors for transport or input failures.

decisions.issue: Root demo fixtures retain a 10:45 second contact and 11:00 evaluation, while the freeze/C examples use 09:32 and 09:40; Hero ground truth retains RAISE_PRIORITY.
decisions.proposal: Have A synchronize fixtures to the approved timeline and re-check ground-truth risk/priority semantics; B must not alter source event times or labels to pass tests.

decisions.issue: Approved next_check_at is 10:30, later than a 10:27:37 commitment deadline, while responsibility-loop material calls for a pre-deadline warning and a receipt example uses 10:27.
decisions.proposal: Do not silently advance the approved value; clarify whether it is an after-deadline check or revise the freeze, and explicitly define next-check and completed-state time behavior without adding a scheduler.

decisions.issue: approved_at uses a server clock, historical demo events are in May while the host date differs, and the existing script/UI can submit a 10:10 collection after the 11:35 uncollected path.
decisions.proposal: Use a trusted injected DemoClock and SystemClock; freeze high-water-mark behavior and two separate legal timelines so an at-risk route never moves backward in time.

decisions.issue: Human approval activation conflicts with analysis examples that already show an ACTIVE commitment; collection completes a promise while fulfillment remains in transit, and PROMISE_FULFILLED is absent from external shipment/audit enums.
decisions.proposal: Distinguish an existing lawful customer-service commitment from a newly activated fulfillment obligation; model PROMISE_FULFILLED only as a derived internal fact unless an existing field can be explicitly approved for audit expression.

decisions.issue: A7 excludes unconfirmed notification drafts from consumer receipts, but the current C application appends a draft after shipment and no dedicated notification-confirmation endpoint exists.
decisions.proposal: Have C perform a second local-chat confirmation and export confirmation evidence while B produces only a draft; any backend persistence must be an approved minimal extension of an existing endpoint, not a new API.

decisions.issue: Responsibility-loop material permits edits to classification, deadline, and action while request schemas expose only executor/next_check_at/recovery_if_missed; approve/shipment lack independent schemas and approved_at has no direct response field.
decisions.proposal: Limit edits to the existing safe fields, add only approved response schema coverage, expose approved_at through auditable service state, and freeze validation behavior for missing approver, unknown cases, expired candidates, and unknown fields.

decisions.issue: AI extraction documentation routes retry failure to HUMAN_REVIEW, while ordering documentation specifies MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID/502; invalid JSON cannot truthfully produce a complete successful ledger.
decisions.proposal: For source conflict with a structurally valid extraction, deterministic rules may choose H1; when a legal extraction cannot be formed, return 502 with an explicit human-takeover UI shape and do not fabricate success.

decisions.issue: No complete policy table defines multi-image conflict, missing-image, confidence, experience-risk, or prohibited-action construction, and hygiene signals must not become medical diagnoses.
decisions.proposal: Have A provide identifiable coverage labels and B encode only approved combination rules; unknown or conflicting evidence stays conservatively H1 without invented statistical thresholds or medical/legal claims.

decisions.issue: Idempotency is only described as unique per case and leaves cross-endpoint keys, duplicate event_id, equal-time events, and analyze behavior after human/event history unresolved.
decisions.proposal: Freeze a case-scoped operation plus normalized-body digest, retain first response/request_id, deduplicate event_id independently, define monotonic ordering including legal equal times, and prohibit analyze from resetting ledger state.

decisions.issue: evaluate lacks a clear model-cache source path, real usage-missing behavior and rule-substitution counting are incomplete, CaseInput does not represent every imported conversation, and formal G5 uses an existing acceptance record protocol.
decisions.proposal: Freeze four runtime-metric definitions and visible evaluate cache provenance, separate raw import from analyzable P0 input, and leave formal G5 acceptance to D/Zack without rewriting historical Claude/QA records.

downstream_constraint.BATCH-02: May create a non-business skeleton after integration receipt; it may not settle decisions.
downstream_constraint.BATCH-03: BLOCKED until X-FREEZE supplies a real, sourced decision record covering implementation-relevant proposals.
